project_type: Multi-repo deployment task spanning React web portals and Flutter patient app
build_system: pnpm + Vite for React; flutter build for Flutter
test_framework: vitest for React, flutter test for Flutter (not required for this task)
build_command: pnpm run build (React), flutter build web (Flutter)
test_command: N/A - deployment task, CI/CD handles tests
verification_instructions: Push changes to trigger CI/CD. React: push to moovv-fit-web triggers deploy-unified.yml. Flutter: use workflow_dispatch with platform=web or push staging tag.
environment_constraints: DO NOT manually deploy to S3 - use GitHub Actions CI/CD. React: deploy-unified.yml with workflow_dispatch. Flutter: deploy.yml with platform=web.
contribution_requirements: No code changes to React app - just trigger CI/CD. Flutter app TASK-6.3 and TASK-6.4 already implemented.
key_patterns: React uses Vite with relative base path (./) - same build works at any subpath. Flutter uses Firebase Remote Config for feature flags with SHOW_WEB_LOGIN defaulting to false on web. Both repos have GitHub Actions for deployment.

directory_structure./mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-web: React web portals - admin, physio, clinic routes all in single SPA. CI/CD: .github/workflows/deploy-unified.yml
directory_structure./mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-mobile: Flutter patient app with web support. CI/CD: .github/workflows/deploy.yml with platform=web option
directory_structure./mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-landing: Landing pages repo with tasks.md to update
